title: Culture, architecture and conversation

location.series: Helsinki illustration examples — PDF derived from the official PowerPoint deck with LibreOffice

slide_intent: Place cultural activity beside architecture so the city is represented as both setting and social life.
strategic_value: Companionship, music and a bicycle can make Helsinki’s built environment feel connected to residents.
demonstration: Three yellow building fronts line the top; figures sitting together, sharing earphones and playing a guitar sit below with a yellow bicycle on gray.
practical_value: Combine one architectural anchor with human activity when a cultural message needs a local setting.
